label: Full — Shoulder, Vents, Chest Pocket, Buttonholes
description: Full decorative handmade lines encompass the shoulder seam, both sleeve and back vents, the chest pocket edges, and all buttonholes, wrapping the jacket in a continuous signature of human craftsmanship that makes the construction process entirely legible from the outside. Each line of hand stitching serves the dual purpose of reinforcing the underlying structure and advertising the tailor's skill, as perfectly executed hand stitches at buttonholes, pocket lips, and vent edges are among the most admired details in sartorial culture. This is the full expression of the handmade tradition and belongs at the summit of bespoke tailoring.
